Problem 2.  Let N = {1, 2, 3,                                                  . . .}                               be the set of all positive integers. Find all functions f  : N →Nsuch that for any positive integers a and b, the following two conditions hold:
  (1) f(ab) = f(a)f(b), and
  (2) at least two of the numbers f(a), f(b) and f(a + b) are equal.
